description: Get fails-to-deliver records for a symbol. Uses FMP when FMP_API_KEY is set, keyless EDGAR otherwise.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

limit.description: Maximum entries per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_fails_to_deliver
title: Fails-to-Deliver Records
